message.content:
A typical medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
If you’re looking at a different size:

| Size (approx. weight) | Calories |
|------------------------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)          | 15–18    |
| Medium (≈123 g)        | 22–25    |
| Large (≈182 g)         | 33–38    |

These values are for raw, fresh tomatoes. Cooking or adding sauces will change the calorie count.
